title: Error scenario tests: network drops, token expiry, server unavailable, WG reconnect
description: Write tests for error scenarios: network drops mid-stream, token expiry and refresh, server unavailable (connection refused, timeout), WG tunnel reconnect. Verify the client and connection manager handle each gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Network drop mid-stream: client detects and reports error
Token expiry: refresh flow works, stale token rejected
Server unavailable: connection manager reports status, retries
WG reconnect: tunnel drops and re-establishes, client recovers
